description: This Java source file defines the TransportClientFactory class, which manages creation and pooling of TransportClient instances for network communication within Apache Spark. It handles connection pooling, client creation, SSL handshake, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: TransportClientFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating, pooling, and managing TransportClient instances for network communication in Spark.

methods.name: TransportClientFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with context and bootstrap list, setting up connection pool, thread group, and memory metrics.

methods.name: getAllMetrics
methods.description: Returns metrics related to Netty memory usage.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a pooled TransportClient for a given host and port, with optional fast-fail behavior.

methods.name: createUnmanagedClient
methods.description: Creates a new, unmanaged TransportClient to a specified host and port, not pooled.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Internal method to establish a new connection to a given InetSocketAddress, performing SSL handshake and bootstrapping.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all pooled clients and shuts down the worker thread group.
